text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "transaction IDs are only 32 bits wide",
      "claim_text": "Transaction IDs are 32 bits wide.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "transaction IDs have limited size (32 bits)"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states 32-bit size."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the XID space holds about 4 billion values",
      "claim_text": "The XID space holds about 4 billion values.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "more than 4 billion transactions"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "2^32", "op": "==", "value": "4 billion"},
      "reasoning": "32 bits implies 2^32 values; passage mentions 4 billion transactions."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "every normal XID has roughly two billion older and two billion newer XIDs",
      "claim_text": "Every normal XID has roughly two billion older and two billion newer XIDs.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "every table must be vacuumed at least once every two billion transactions",
      "claim_text": "Every table must be vacuumed at least once every two billion transactions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S4", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "running past that without vacuuming means permanent, unrecoverable data loss",
      "claim_text": "Running past two billion transactions without vacuuming means permanent, unrecoverable data loss.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S3", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says data is still there, so not permanent loss."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "default autovacuum_freeze_max_age of 200 million transactions",
      "claim_text": "The default autovacuum_freeze_max_age is 200 million transactions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "entails", "sub": "The default, 200 million transactions"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the anti-wraparound autovacuum kicks in after only about 10% of that two-billion window",
      "claim_text": "With the default autovacuum_freeze_max_age, the anti-wraparound autovacuum kicks in after about 10% of the two-billion window.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "entails", "sub": "200 million transactions"},
        {"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails", "sub": "two billion"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "200 million / 2 billion", "op": "==", "value": "10%"},
      "reasoning": "200M is 10% of 2B."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "effective maximum for vacuum_freeze_table_age is 95% of autovacuum_freeze_max_age",
      "claim_text": "The effective maximum for vacuum_freeze_table_age is 95% of autovacuum_freeze_max_age.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "with the default it can be at most 180 million",
      "claim_text": "With the default autovacuum_freeze_max_age, vacuum_freeze_table_age can be at most 180 million.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "0.95 * autovacuum_freeze_max_age"},
        {"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "entails", "sub": "200 million transactions"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "0.95 * 200 million", "op": "==", "value": "180 million"},
      "reasoning": "0.95 * 200M = 190M, not 180M."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "warnings start when the oldest XIDs are forty million transactions from wraparound",
      "claim_text": "Warnings start when the oldest XIDs are forty million transactions from wraparound.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "new XIDs are refused once fewer than three million remain",
      "claim_text": "New XIDs are refused once fewer than three million transactions remain until wraparound.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "leaving a 37-million-transaction window between the first warning and the hard stop",
      "claim_text": "There is a 37-million-transaction window between the first warning and the hard stop.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "forty million"},
        {"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "three million"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "40 million - 3 million", "op": "==", "value": "37 million"},
      "reasoning": "40M - 3M = 37M."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Once XID assignment stops, no new transactions of any kind can be started",
      "claim_text": "Once XID assignment stops, no new transactions of any kind can be started.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says read-only transactions can be started."
    }
  ]
}
